info.name: QA-19 MANUAL — SUITE 12 — STAGING
info.description:
Collection chạy cùng BE15-Assignments-Qase-IMPORT.csv.

Điền credential và ID fixture trong environment trước khi chạy. Collection tạo fixture có tiền tố AUTO-BE15 và dọn dẹp ở folder 99. Không dùng top-level await để tương thích Newman.

Qase synchronization: TC_ASSIGNMENT_01..76 map to Qase case IDs 1497..1572. Newman assertion names include [Qase #<id>] for traceability.

QA-19 staging adapter: execute through run-all-suites.mjs with run-owned actors/IDs. Original seed identities are replaced at runtime; no local signing key permitted.
QA-19 REGRESSION SCOPE: logout cleanup omitted; logout-dependent cases BLOCKED under BUG-AUTH-STAGING-SEED-LOGOUT-500. All other API and fixture-deletion expectations remain unchanged.
Fixture revision: QA19-fixtures-2026-10-10-v3. Validation/permission expectations unchanged.
POSTMAN IMPORT EDITION: run entire collection, 1 iteration, selected matching SUITE staging environment. CONTROL setup/cleanup is embedded; no Node runner required.

async function login(email,password){const r=await api('POST','/auth/login',null,{email,password},[200]);if(!r.json.accessToken)throw Error('Missing fixture accessToken');sessions.push(r.json);return r.json;}
if(qa19Rows().length)throw Error('Pending QA fixture ledger: run CONTROL CLEANUP before new setup');
const u=r.json.user;if(!u?.id)throw Error('Missing fixture user ID');

async function cls(key,teacherId,students){const r=await api('POST','/classes',admin.accessToken,{name:run+' '+key,level:'B1',startDate:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),teacherId:Number(teacherId)},[201]);const id=r.json.id;qa19Record('class',id,{name:run+' '+key});for(const studentId of students){const m=await api('POST','/classes/'+id+'/members',admin.accessToken,{studentId:Number(studentId)},[201]);qa19Record('member',m.json.memberId||m.json.id,{classId:id});}return id;}
cv.set('_qa19SetupSessions_'+suite,JSON.stringify(sessions));console.log('QA19 SETUP READY suite '+suite+'; fixture IDs saved in environment');
